canonical_project: Pecos County Data Center / GW Ranch
owner: Amazon Data Services; Pacifico Energy power-campus developer

location.power_project_location: Highway 18 approximately 17 miles north of Fort Stockton, Pecos County, TX 79735

capacity_notes: 7.65 GW is Pacifico/TCEQ permitted gross gas generation capacity for GW Ranch, not disclosed Amazon IT load. TCEQ technical summary describes a 5,000 MW nominal-output plant for an on-site AI data center; Pacifico describes over 5 GW deliverable private-grid power, plus 1.8 GW battery storage and up to 750 MWac solar.
status_detail: TCEQ air permits issued for Pacifico GW Ranch Energy Center; TDLR architectural-barriers registrations filed for Amazon Data Services Buildings A, B, and C. TDLR records list projected 2026-08-01 construction start and 2026-12-01 completion, but official current status remains Project Registered.

tceq_air_permits.description: Natural gas-fired simple cycle power plant at a greenfield site in Pecos County to provide electricity for an on-site AI data center, with no capability to sell to or receive power from the local utility distribution system.

history.previous: filed / permitted power campus; construction start reported for 2026; first power targeted 2027
history.reason: Normalized to SKILL.md status vocabulary after official TDLR/TCEQ review.
Three TDLR records and TCEQ permit materials are publicly accessible official sources.

why_not_in_baseline: Not among the 208 canonical_project names; new Amazon/Pacifico Pecos County behind-the-meter data-center power campus, distinct from baseline Microsoft Pecos and other Texas Stargate/Abilene entries.

contradictions.issue: Capacity is reported as 7.65 GW in Pacifico's project materials and media coverage, while TCEQ's preliminary determination describes 5,000 MW nominal output and Pacifico's project page says over 5 GW deliverable power. Treat 7.65 GW as permitted gross gas-generation ceiling, not confirmed data-center IT load.

TDLR records show projected construction start on 2026-08-01, while the official current status field is Project Registered. Do not classify as site work-construction without separate official or imagery-backed evidence.
